errors.class_mismatch.cause: the event's source class differs from the class declared for its source.
errors.class_mismatch.fix: align the emitted agentcesourceclass with the profile's declared class.
errors.context_mismatch.cause: the event's JSON-LD @context is not the canonical evidence context.
errors.duplicate_id.cause: two events share the same id; the later one was quarantined.
errors.duplicate_id.fix: give every event a stable, unique id at the source.
errors.environment.cryptography_source_b: cryptography was built from source because no prebuilt wheel is published for this platform.
install Rust and OpenSSL 3 before `uv sync` (macOS: `brew install openssl@3`, then set OPENSSL_DIR to its prefix).
errors.environment.cryptography_unavaila: the cryptography package the engine signs and verifies with is missing or does not import.
install the engine's dependencies with `uv sync`; where no prebuilt wheel exists, install Rust and OpenSSL 3 first.
errors.environment.python_unsupported.ca: the running Python is older than the interpreter the engine supports.
errors.environment.python_unsupported.fi: run the engine under Python 3.12 or newer (`uv python install 3.12`).
errors.input.bundle_manifest_file_too_la: a manifest-listed file is over the per-file size limit.
split large evidence into more, smaller files, or reference bulk content by an opaque locator instead of inlining it (SPEC R12).
errors.input.bundle_manifest_mismatch.ca: a stream file's digest does not match the manifest.
errors.input.bundle_manifest_mismatch.fi: regenerate the manifest after any change to the stream files.
errors.input.bundle_manifest_missing.cau: the evidence bundle has no manifest.json.
errors.input.bundle_manifest_missing.fix: an agent writes a bundle by running with the agentce_emit emitter on: set `AGENTCE_EMIT=1 AGENTCE_EMIT_OUT=<dir>` and see docs/integrate.md; to watch one built, run `examples/custom-loop/run.sh <dir>` from a checkout, then `agentce validate --bundle <dir>`.
errors.input.catalog_mismatch.cause: a --catalog-dir carries an id@version the --catalog request did not name.
errors.input.catalog_mismatch.fix: pass --catalog-dir for the catalog you named, or name the id@version the directory carries.
errors.input.catalog_missing.cause: --catalog was given but names no catalog.
errors.input.catalog_missing.fix: pass --catalog <id@version>, or leave --catalog out to assess against the baseline.
errors.input.catalog_not_found.cause: no base catalog was found under the expected path.
errors.input.catalog_not_found.fix: run from the repository root or pass --catalog-dir to a catalog directory.
errors.input.catalog_unresolved.cause: a requested catalog id@version does not resolve to any catalog directory.
errors.input.catalog_unresolved.fix: use an available <id>@<version>, or pass --catalog-dir <dir> for a catalog on disk.
errors.input.catalog_unverified.cause: a --catalog-dir catalog is unsigned, or its signature does not verify against the effective trust root.
errors.input.catalog_unverified.fix: point --catalog-dir at a catalog whose catalog.sig.json verifies, or pass --trust-root <file> (or set AGENTCE_TRUST_ROOT) for the root that signed it.
errors.input.coverage_denominator_manife: a coverage denominator's manifest file is nested too deeply to parse safely.
flatten the denominator manifest's structure; it exceeds the engine's safe nesting depth.
errors.input.deviation_invalid.cause: the deviation register is not a well-formed mapping with a `deviations:` list of mapping entries, or fails a rule of SPEC §13.3.4 (control not in the catalog, wrong outcome, missing field, same approver as owner, or lifetime over the maximum).
errors.input.deviation_invalid.fix: correct the deviation register and re-run.
errors.input.domain_binding_invalid.caus: the domain binding is not safe YAML: a disallowed construct, or a structure nested too deeply to parse safely.
errors.input.domain_binding_invalid.fix: remove custom YAML tags and flatten deep nesting in the domain binding file.
errors.input.event_structure_too_deep.ca: an evidence event line is nested too deeply to parse safely.
errors.input.event_structure_too_deep.fi: flatten the event's structure; reference deeply nested content by an opaque locator instead (SPEC R12).
errors.input.for_preset.cause: --for names a preset assess does not know.
errors.input.for_preset.fix: choose one of: ci, compliance, engineering, security, share.
errors.input.init_exists.cause: init would overwrite a profile or domain binding that already exists.
errors.input.init_exists.fix: pass --force to overwrite, or --out <dir> to write somewhere else.
errors.input.nothing_evaluated.cause: no control reached conformant, non-conformant, or insufficient_evidence, so the run judged nothing.
errors.input.nothing_evaluated.fix: emit under the subject and source the profile declares, and record the evidence the catalog's controls apply to.
errors.input.profile_invalid.cause: the applicability profile is not safe YAML: a disallowed construct, or a structure nested too deeply to parse safely.
errors.input.profile_invalid.fix: remove custom YAML tags and flatten deep nesting; regenerate the profile from `agentce init`.
errors.input.profile_missing.cause: the applicability profile was not supplied.
errors.input.records_none_recognised.cau: the records folder holds no OpenTelemetry GenAI or OpenInference trace export the engine can read.
errors.input.records_none_recognised.fix: point assess at a folder of OTLP/JSON trace exports (.json, .jsonl or .ndjson).
errors.input.records_no_genai_spans.caus: the folder holds OpenTelemetry traces, but none of their spans is a GenAI operation the engine maps.
errors.input.records_no_genai_spans.fix: instrument the agent with OpenTelemetry GenAI or OpenInference, then export its traces.
errors.input.records_out_collides.cause: the output folder would overwrite records: it is the records folder, holds them, or lies inside that folder with files that are not a previous run's output.
errors.input.records_out_collides.fix: choose an output folder outside the records folder with --out, or an empty one.
errors.input.records_not_a_directory.cau: the records folder does not exist or is not a directory.
errors.input.records_not_a_directory.fix: pass a folder of OpenTelemetry GenAI or OpenInference trace exports.
errors.input.records_source_ambiguous.ca: both a records folder and --bundle were given.
errors.input.records_source_ambiguous.fi: pass either a folder of trace exports or --bundle <dir>, not both.
errors.input.records_subject_ambiguous.c: the profile declares several subjects, and a records folder is assessed as one.
errors.input.records_subject_ambiguous.f: declare one subject in the profile, or assess each agent's records folder separately.
errors.input.package_requires_bundle.cau: --package-for-sharing works only with --bundle/--profile; a records-folder run cannot be reproduced from a --bundle re-run.
errors.input.package_requires_bundle.fix: pass --bundle and --profile instead of a records folder, or drop --package-for-sharing.
errors.input.package_path_overlap.cause: --out overlaps --bundle, --profile, --domain, or a --catalog-dir: packaging would read from or write into the tree it is producing.
errors.input.package_path_overlap.fix: point --out somewhere outside every input path, then re-run.
errors.input.diff_field_not_string.cause: diff was given an assertion whose control, subject, or outcome field is present but is not a JSON string.
errors.input.diff_extra_argument.cause: diff was given more than the two positional arguments it takes.
errors.input.diff_unrecognized_flag.caus: diff was given a flag it does not recognize.
errors.input.diff_unrecognized_flag.fix: pass --format text|json|md, or drop the flag.
errors.input.readiness_unrecognized_flag: readiness was given a flag it does not recognize.
pass --gaps, --deviations, or --catalog-dir, or drop the flag.
errors.input.trust_root_invalid.cause: the trust root supplied by --trust-root or AGENTCE_TRUST_ROOT could not be loaded.
errors.input.trust_root_invalid.fix: pass --trust-root <file> pointing at a trust root in the form of the engine's vendored data/trust/dev-root.json.
errors.insufficient_evidence.cause: the minimum evidence to judge the control was not present in the window.
errors.insufficient_evidence.fix: instrument the missing corroborating stream (see the control's techniques).
errors.internal.unexpected.fix: re-run with --debug to see the stack trace, then file an issue.
errors.oversize.cause: the event exceeds the size limit and was refused.
errors.oversize.fix: reference bulk content by an opaque locator instead of inlining it (SPEC R12).
errors.schema_invalid.cause: an event failed schema validation and was not ingested.
errors.schema_invalid.fix: fix the emitter or adapter so the event matches agentce-evidence.schema.json.
errors.sign.trust_root_requires_kms.caus: --write-trust-root needs an exportable public key, and the sigstore-public and sigstore-private profiles have none.
errors.sign.key_unreadable.cause: the signing key file could not be parsed as an unencrypted PEM private key.
errors.sign.key_unreadable.fix: supply an unencrypted Ed25519 private key PEM (openssl genpkey -algorithm ed25519 -out key.pem, or agentce catalog sign --new-key <path>).
errors.catalog.init_family_invalid.cause: the --id given to catalog init is not 2-4 uppercase letters.
errors.catalog.init_family_invalid.fix: pass --id as 2-4 uppercase letters, e.g. --id ACM.
errors.catalog.init_family_collision.cau: the control family named by --id is already used by a vendored base or overlay catalog.
errors.catalog.init_exists.cause: catalog init would overwrite a scaffolded file that already exists.
errors.catalog.init_exists.fix: pass --force to overwrite, or a different <dir>.
errors.catalog.sign_not_a_catalog.cause: the directory given to catalog sign has no catalog.yaml.
errors.catalog.sign_not_a_catalog.fix: pass a catalog directory, or scaffold one first with agentce catalog init <dir>.
errors.catalog.sign_lint_failed.cause: the catalog fails agentce catalog lint.
errors.catalog.sign_lint_failed.fix: fix the lint problems (agentce catalog lint <dir>) before signing.
errors.catalog.sign_key_missing.cause: catalog sign signs with an operator-held key, and neither --key nor --new-key was given.
errors.catalog.sign_key_algorithm.cause: the signing key given to catalog sign is not an Ed25519 private key.
errors.catalog.sign_key_algorithm.fix: supply an Ed25519 key, or generate one with --new-key.
errors.catalog.sign_key_unreadable.cause: the signing key file given to catalog sign could not be parsed as an unencrypted PEM private key.
errors.catalog.sign_key_unreadable.fix: supply an unencrypted Ed25519 private key PEM, or generate one with --new-key.
errors.catalog.sign_key_inside_catalog.c: the --key or --new-key path resolves inside the catalog directory being signed.
errors.catalog.sign_key_inside_catalog.f: write the signing key outside the catalog directory.
errors.catalog.sign_new_key_exists.cause: the path given to --new-key already exists.
errors.catalog.sign_new_key_exists.fix: pass a path that does not exist yet, or reuse it with --key instead.
errors.catalog.sign_exists.cause: the catalog directory already carries a catalog.sig.json.
errors.catalog.sign_exists.fix: pass --force to re-sign, or remove the existing signature first.
errors.catalog.sign_trust_root_inside_ca: the --write-trust-root path resolves inside the catalog directory being signed.
write the trust root outside the catalog directory.
errors.catalog.support_matrix_multi.caus: --support-matrix was given while linting a directory that holds more than one catalog.
errors.catalog.support_matrix_multi.fix: pass the single catalog's own directory, not a directory holding several.
errors.catalog.support_matrix_inside_cat: the --support-matrix path resolves inside the catalog directory being linted.
write the support matrix outside the catalog directory.
errors.time_order.cause: an event's timestamp is out of order within its stream.
errors.time_order.fix: emit events in time order, or correct the source clock.
errors.unknown_source.cause: the event's source is not declared in the applicability profile.
errors.unknown_source.fix: declare the source under the subject's evidence_sources with its trust class.
errors.unknown_type.cause: the event's @type is not a recognised evidence type.
errors.unknown_type.fix: map the event to a canonical evidence type in the adapter (SPEC §12).
errors.verify.report_claim_malformed.cau: claim.json exists but is not valid JSON.
errors.verify.report_claim_malformed.fix: regenerate the report; claim.json must be well-formed JSON.
errors.verify.report_claim_tampered.caus: claim.json does not match the digest the signature covers.
errors.verify.report_claim_tampered.fix: the claim was altered after signing; regenerate and re-sign the report.
errors.verify.report_engine_mismatch.cau: the report was produced by a different engine build (version, spec version, or package digest) than the one re-running it.
errors.verify.report_engine_mismatch.fix: install the same engine build the report names, then re-run verify.
errors.verify.report_evidence_tampered.c: the packaged bundle, applicability profile, domain binding, or a catalog no longer matches the digest the manifest recorded.
errors.verify.report_evidence_tampered.f: the packaged evidence was altered after signing; regenerate and re-sign the report.
errors.verify.report_keyid_mismatch.caus: no claimant signature carries the keyid --expect-keyid named.
errors.verify.report_keyid_mismatch.fix: confirm the keyid with the sender, or drop --expect-keyid.
errors.verify.report_manifest_tampered.c: manifest.json does not match the digest the signature covers.
errors.verify.report_manifest_tampered.f: the manifest was altered after signing; regenerate and re-sign the report.
errors.verify.report_no_claim.cause: the report directory has no claim.json: it was never signed, or the wrong directory was given.
errors.verify.report_no_claim.fix: pass the directory agentce assess wrote and agentce sign signed.
errors.verify.report_no_trust_root.cause: the report has no embedded trust-root.json, and --signer-trust-root was not given.
errors.verify.report_no_trust_root.fix: pass --signer-trust-root <file>, or ask the sender to re-sign with sign --write-trust-root.
errors.verify.report_output_tampered.cau: a manifest-tracked output file is missing, or its bytes no longer match the manifest.
errors.verify.report_output_tampered.fix: the report was altered after signing; regenerate and re-sign it.
errors.verify.report_reproduction_mismat: an offline re-run from the packaged evidence does not reproduce a canonical output byte for byte.
run agentce diff between the shipped and re-run outputs for the full picture.
errors.verify.report_signature_invalid.c: no claimant signature verifies against the trust root.
errors.verify.report_signature_invalid.f: confirm the trust root holds the signer's real key, or re-sign the report.
errors.verify.report_subject_missing.cau: the signed statement is missing a required subject (manifest.json or claim.json).
errors.verify.report_subject_missing.fix: re-sign the report: agentce sign <report-dir> --as claimant.
errors.verify.report_unsigned.fix: sign the report first: agentce sign <report-dir> --as claimant.
errors.warning.pilot_window.cause: the observation window is shorter than 90 days and is recorded as a pilot.
errors.warning.pilot_window.fix: extend the window to at least 90 days for a full assessment.
errors.warning.stale_component.cause: a declared component digest differs from the one observed in the window (STALE).
errors.warning.stale_component.fix: update the profile's declared component digests and re-run.
next.conformant: No gaps. Run the assessment again when the agent, its evidence, or the catalog changes.
next.incomplete: Supply the missing evidence, or complete the manual checks, for the controls listed under Top gaps, then run the assessment again.
next.non-conformant: Fix the non-conformant controls listed under Top gaps, then run the assessment again.
readiness.deviation_expired_ignored: {control}: deviation expired {expiry}; ignored and reported, the control remains non-conformant
report.activity_none_agents: no agent identity found in the records
report.activity_none_undeclared: every agent, tool, and model your records show is declared
report.activity_recorder_enforcement_poi: a system that could have stopped it
report.activity_recorder_independent_sys: a system the agent cannot edit
report.activity_undeclared_heading: Not yet declared in your profile
report.affected_persons: Affected persons may obtain an explanation and raise concerns through the deployer's published contact channel (EU AI Act Arts. 26(11), 85, 86).
report.auditor_by_clause_none: no control in this run cites an external framework clause
report.auditor_deviation_unavailable: the deviation register for `{control}` was not available when this report was rendered; only the control id is shown.
report.auditor_deviations_none: no accepted deviation on this run
report.auditor_intro: This view lists every clause your records were checked against, one row per control and subject, with the full evidence trail so you can look up any external clause and see the record behind it. It draws no new conclusion beyond what report.md already shows -- it selects and orders the same records differently, and it is not itself a certification.
report.auditor_manual_none: no manual or semi-automated control on this run
report.auditor_oscal_text: The same findings are also available as an OSCAL 1.1.2 Assessment Results document (`oscal-ar.json`/`oscal-ar.xml`) and as one evidence pack per subject (`packs/<subject>/pack.json`).
report.blind_spots_heading: Where your records can't show it yet
report.blind_spots_no_population_heading: Records that don't show enough, with no single fix
report.blind_spots_no_population_text: The records show every kind of evidence {control} asks for, but not enough of it in the shape the control expects -- a --domain binding may be needed to identify the relevant decisions; see the control's documentation for what it needs.
report.blind_spots_none: every check either has enough evidence, or nothing here would unlock more
report.blind_spots_row: unlocks {checks_unlocked} check(s), needed by {needed_by} more; rung {ladder_rung} -- {step}. Adapters that can supply this: {adapters}.
report.buyer_answer_conformant: {control} meets what this question asks, based on the records this run checked.
report.buyer_answer_insufficient_evidenc: The records don't show enough evidence yet for {control} to answer this question.
report.buyer_answer_non-conformant: {control} does not meet what this question asks, based on the records this run checked.
report.buyer_answer_not_applicable: {control} does not apply to this run's declared scope.
report.buyer_answer_partial: {control} partly meets what this question asks; not every check passed.
report.buyer_framework_none: no control in this run cites {framework} {version} yet
report.buyer_gap_step_unavailable: no next step is known for this gap yet.
report.buyer_how_to_check: Re-run this report offline and compare the result: `agentce verify --report {folder}`.
report.buyer_how_to_check_unpackaged: This report was not packaged for offline re-verification; re-run the assessment with `--package-for-sharing` to produce one that can be.
report.buyer_intro: This view answers generated questionnaire questions (CAIQ, the AI Controls Matrix) from the same records report.md already draws on. It draws no new conclusion and is not itself a certification -- it is evidence against the standard and version named below.
report.gaps_more: {n, plural, one {+# more gap} other {+# more gaps}}
report.manual_checklist_not_yet_evaluate: recording this control's checklist answer as a live outcome is not built yet (SPEC §13.3.4 Stage 3); it stays not_assessed until then. See agentce-prepare-to-share's checklist procedure for the next step.
report.security_citations_none: no standards citations on the controls this run touched
report.security_drift_none: every tool and model your records show is declared
report.security_enforcement_scope_note: This answers whether anything could have stopped this run's actions at the whole-run level: the count of irreversible actions next to the count of approvals and denials this run recorded. It does not link one action to the check that covered it.
report.security_intro: AgentCE doesn't block anything. It reads what your guardrails recorded and shows where they could have stopped an action and where nothing could have.
report.see_report: See report.md in {dir} for every control.
report.title: AgentCE conformance report
verdict.conformant: Conformant — every applicable control met its expectations with evidence.
verdict.incomplete: Incomplete — no control failed, but not every applicable control is demonstrated.
verdict.non-conformant: Non-conformant — at least one applicable control failed.
